basic.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
basic.summary:
I have 11 years of experience.
Principal Machine Learning Engineer with experience building and shipping large-scale ML, ranking, reinforcement learning, multi-agent AI systems, and LLM-powered production platforms across ads, conversational AI, retrieval, optimization, recommendation, and quantitative finance. Strong background in end-to-end ML architecture spanning distributed training, retrieval systems, RLHF, ranking, experimentation, feature platforms, low-latency serving, and cloud-scale infrastructure. Most effective in problems at the intersection of multi-objective optimization, reinforcement learning, agent orchestration, personalization, ranking systems, and generative AI productionization.

experience.title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer
bullets: - Conversational advertiser copilot and multi-agent AI platform
Technical owner of end-to-end ML architecture for conversational advertiser copilot powering ad campaign generation, optimization, retrieval, policy validation, and advertiser workflows.
Led 0-to-1 transition from monolithic prompting into a modular multi-agent orchestration graph, enabling component-level evaluation, controllability, policy isolation, and production scalability.

Architected multi-agent orchestration system with specialized agents for routing, retrieval, planning, creative generation, ranking, memory, and policy validation using LangGraph and Pydantic contracts.

Built multi-turn tool-call extraction system using fine-tuned Llama models and Transformers, predicting normalized API actions such as budget updates, geo targeting, and campaign modifications from conversational history.
Fine-tuned open-weight LLMs and SLMs using PyTorch, PEFT, LoRA, and TRL for structured generation, tool calling, ad copy generation, and conversational reasoning tasks.
Implemented RLHF pipeline using SFT and DPO with custom reward models trained on advertiser acceptance, policy compliance, rewrite preferences, and human quality signals.
Designed two-stage modeling strategy combining frontier teacher models such as GPT-4o and Claude with distilled open-weight production SLMs, reducing latency by 3x and cost by 5x.
Served production inference workloads using vLLM with quantization, batching, KV-cache reuse, autoscaling GPU infrastructure, and low-latency structured generation.
Built hybrid retrieval stack using Elasticsearch BM25 retrieval, FAISS semantic retrieval, reranking models, and Redis caching over policy documents, templates, metadata, and historical creatives.
Designed campaign knowledge graph using Neo4j and normalized Postgres schemas connecting advertisers, campaigns, audiences, creatives, geographies, and policy entities.
Built session-state and memory layer using Redis and Postgres with typed schema validation and durable multi-turn conversational state management.
Implemented production-grade service orchestration using gRPC, retry middleware, circuit breakers, timeout handling, and distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry.

Generated large-scale synthetic multi-turn conversational training datasets using GPT-4o and Claude teacher models with slot overwrites, paraphrases, edge-case workflows, and contradictory refinements.
Built training-data QC pipelines including schema validation, replay testing, policy checks, deduplication, and experiment lineage tracking.
Architected multi-stage policy validation pipeline combining rules engines, XGBoost classifiers, LLM judges, and RAG-grounded policy reasoning.
Migrated production inference from hosted APIs to self-hosted GPU infrastructure using vLLM on EKS with autoscaling, canary deployments, and MLflow model registry integration.
Built streaming interaction logging platform using Kafka/MSK ingesting tool calls, chat interactions, policy events, and advertiser feedback at millions of events per day.
Developed large-scale batch ETL pipelines using Spark on EMR, Airflow/MWAA orchestration, Delta Lake, Parquet, Snowflake, S3, and Trino federated querying.
Built online and offline feature store infrastructure using Feast with Redis online serving and Snowflake offline storage supporting sub-10ms online reads.
Implemented point-in-time feature correctness, feature drift monitoring, schema validation, and training-serving parity guarantees.
Built comprehensive evaluation harness measuring tool-call accuracy, retrieval recall, grounding faithfulness, ranking quality, latency, policy violations, and conversational correctness.
Ran large-scale online A/B experimentation across model families, prompt strategies, retrieval systems, orchestration architectures, policy ordering, and clarification thresholds.
Established production observability using Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, and distributed tracing across all agent steps and inference components.
Built CI/CD and ML deployment infrastructure using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Docker, Helm, Argo CD, MLflow, Terraform, and EKS.
Managed large-scale GPU infrastructure on A100 and H100 clusters with autoscaling, spot capacity fallback, chargeback controls, and production cost optimization.

experience.title: Vice President, Global Asset Allocation
bullets: Built large-scale quantitative research and portfolio optimization systems for systematic trading strategies across equities, rates, FX, credit, commodities, and macro asset classes.
Led migration of monolithic research infrastructure into containerized, reproducible distributed pipelines enabling cloud-scale portfolio research and backtesting.
Built market-data lake on GCS ingesting cross-asset datasets including prices, returns, FX, rates, futures, credit, macro, broker, and alternative data.
Built distributed ETL and orchestration pipelines using Spark on Dataproc, Cloud Workflows, Cloud Composer/Airflow, and BigQuery.
Developed point-in-time correct feature engineering pipelines eliminating look-ahead bias in historical backtesting workflows.
Engineered cross-asset feature libraries covering momentum, carry, value, volatility, trend, liquidity, macro-regime, and seasonality factors.
Trained return forecasting and regime detection models using XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, Bayesian methods, and hierarchical statistical models.
Built distributed hyperparameter optimization infrastructure using Optuna across Compute Engine worker pools.
Implemented portfolio optimization systems including mean-variance optimization, risk parity, volatility targeting, transaction-cost-aware optimization, and slippage adjustment.
Architected distributed backtesting engine using Ray and Spark, reducing full-sample cross-asset backtests from multiple days to hours.
Built large-scale model training and deployment infrastructure using Vertex AI, Docker, GKE, Artifact Registry, MLflow, and W&B.
Developed real-time signal generation and portfolio construction services using FastAPI, gRPC, Redis/Memorystore, and distributed cloud infrastructure.
Built production reconciliation, drift monitoring, PnL validation, and exposure monitoring workflows.
Implemented CI/CD infrastructure with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Docker, Terraform, and automated canary rollouts.
Established observability and production monitoring using Datadog, Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, runbooks, and on-call alerting systems.

experience.title: FICC Strat (FX Options & Macro CVA)
bullets: Built real-time FX options pricing systems using stochastic volatility models including SABR and Heston.
Developed quantitative infrastructure for trading desk pricing, risk analytics, and derivatives modeling.
Improved pricing latency and quote turnaround time for sales and trading workflows.
Worked on macro CVA and derivatives pricing systems for FICC trading operations.

experience.title: Summer Associate, FICC Strats
bullets: Prototyped PDE-based interest rate derivatives pricer adopted by the rates trading desk.
Worked on quantitative modeling and numerical methods for derivatives pricing.

experience.title: Intern Research Assistant
bullets: Developed image segmentation algorithms for medical imaging applications using variational methods.
Conducted research in image processing and computer vision techniques.
